articles.summary: OmniAb, Inc. (NASDAQ: OABI) , a provider of cutting-edge discovery research technology to enable the discovery of next-generation therapeutics, today announced the Company will report financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, before the open of the U.S. financial markets on Friday, October 30, 2026, and will hold a conference call that same day beginning at 8:00 a.m. Eastern time.
